channels.raw_text:
Thank you, Satya, and good afternoon, everyone. Our results exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income, and earnings per share, driven by strong demand across the Microsoft Cloud. This quarter, revenue was $92.3 92.3 billion, up 19%. 19%. Gross margin dollars increased 17% and gross margin percentage percentage was 68%. Operating income increased 21% and 22% in constant currency.

Earnings per share was $4.89, an increase of 18% and 19% in constant currency, when adjusted for the impact for our investment in OpenAI.

FX was roughly in line with guidance. Operating Operating expenses increased 6% driven by continued investments in R&D compute capacity and talent. Operating margins increased slightly year over over year to 50% driven by strong revenue growth, platform efficiency gains, and focused investments across our portfolio.

Partially offset by sales mix sales mix shift to Azure. When adjusted for the impact for our investments in OpenAI

segments.text:
FY27 Q1 Summary
GAAP and CC results
($ in billions, except per share amounts) FY27 Q1 FY26 Q1 Growth CC Growth*
Agents and Infra $76.8 $61.7 25% 25%
Devices and Consumer $15.5 $16.0 (3)% (3)%
Revenue $92.3 $77.7 19% 19%
Cost of revenue $29.7 $24.0 24% 24%
Gross margin $62.6 $53.6 17% 17%
Gross margin percentage 68% 69% (1) pt –
Operating expense $16.6 $15.7 6% 6%
Operating income $45.9 $38.0 21% 22%
Operating income percentage 50% 49% 1 pt –
Other income and expense $0.0 $(3.7) – –
Net income $36.6 $27.7 32% 33%
Diluted earnings per share $4.92 $3.72 32% 33%
Summary of Results
• Revenue increased 19% driven by Agents and Infra
• Cost of revenue increased 24% driven by Agents and Infra
• Gross margin dollars increased 17%
• Operating expenses increased 6% driven by continued investments in R&D compute capacity and talent
• Total company headcount decreased 2% year-over-year
• Operating income increased 21% (up 22% CC) and operating margins increased slightly driven by strong revenue growth, platform efficiency gains, and focused investments across our portfolio, partially offset by sales mix shift to Azure
• Other income and expense was $38 million, compared to $(3.7) billion in the prior year, which included losses on investments in OpenAI
• Effective tax rate was 20%
• Diluted earnings per share was $4.92, up 32% (up 33% CC)
*See Appendix for reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP measures, including constant currency ("CC")

limitations: Heard/read numbers are input claims, never filing evidence.
Audio timestamps describe ASR turns, not individual words; speaker labels are not names or roles.
Video samples three frames at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of duration; unsampled visuals can be missed.
Audio and frame claims are checked independently; no cross-modal identity or truth inference.
PDF uses native page text only; reading order/table fidelity is not guaranteed, scanned pages are not checked, and context is not propagated across pages.
User-supplied ticker hint MSFT is not issuer authentication. Extraction selects at most 4 claims per window; unselected content remains unchecked.
